messages:
Maya Patel: FYI customer ACMECorp says their invoice total is off by ~€0.42 vs dashboard. They ran a report and find per-request rounding seems to create microcent drift across ~8k line items.
Raja Singh: ugh. do we have the invoice lines + raw metering? can you paste a snippet?
Maya Patel: pasted below (redacted IDs). note currency is EUR and they have mixed per-request prices (some requests return 0.0004323 EUR after per-token calc). invoice sums uses rounding to 2 decimals per line.

```
invoice_lines.csv
request_ts,request_id,tokens,unit_price_eur,raw_amount_eur,rounded_line_eur
2026-02-28T23:59:58Z,req_aa,14,0.000031,0.000434,0.00
2026-02-28T23:59:59Z,req_bb,320,0.000031,0.00992,0.01
2026-02-28T23:59:59Z,req_cc,1,0.000031,0.000031,0.00
... ~8k lines ...
```
Maya Patel: Dashboard shows aggregated total = 37.1284 EUR (we store full precision). Invoice generator currently does: sum(round(line_amount, 2)) which gives 37.06 EUR. Customer expects either sum(round(line_amount,2)) or round(sum(line_amount),2) consistently — but they previously were billed using round(sum(...),2) until last billing change.
Thomas Li: do we have a changelog for invoice generator? could be the template change from per-line rounding to per-invoice rounding.
billing-bot: Invoice generator v2 deployed 2026-02-25 04:12:09 UTC — default behavior: per-line rounding to 2 decimals. Previous behavior v1 used invoice-level rounding.
Raja Singh: OK that explains it. Two follow-ups: 1) confirm whether tax (VAT) is applied before or after rounding; 2) provide a remediation path for ACMECorp invoice if they want previous behavior.
Emma Johnson: VAT is applied per invoice after subtotal in current pipeline. We also have separate VAT line item storage (full precision) then we round VAT to 2 decimals when generating final invoice output.
Maya Patel: customer insists it's regression; they have legal requirement to show per-line tax breakdown. They want a corrected invoice for Feb 2026 and a statement of what changed.
Raja Singh: proposed remediation: regenerate invoice using legacy rounding (round(subtotal,2) then round(VAT,2) ). We'll need finance approval for credits > €0.5. Also need to determine timeframe of impacted invoices.
Thomas Li: quick query to find scope (run on metering DB):
```
SELECT invoice_id, COUNT(*) as line_count, SUM(raw_amount) as subtotal_precise,
       SUM(ROUND(raw_amount,2)) as subtotal_perline
FROM invoice_line_items
WHERE currency = 'EUR' AND invoice_date >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY invoice_id
HAVING ABS(subtotal_precise - subtotal_perline) > 0.01;
```
Thomas Li: that'll give invoices where per-line vs invoice-level diff > 1 cent. We should also join billing_config to see which customers opted into legacy mode.
Maya Patel: I ran that and found ~14 invoices in Feb-Mar window. ACMECorp's was off by €0.42 (matches their report). Full SQL output attached in the ticket (link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-2026-1243).
Raja Singh: for the external reply: suggest 1) we can regenerate invoice using previous rounding and issue a corrected invoice (credit + corrected PDF), 2) explain the engine change (deployed 2026-02-25) and provide precise diff amount and how we compute VAT, 3) offer an option to opt-in to either rounding behavior for future invoices.
Emma Johnson: note: regulatory implications — in some regions per-line rounding is legally required. Need legal/finance sign-off before changing default. Escalating to Finance (cc @FinanceTeam) in ticket.
Maya Patel: repro steps for engineering (to include in ticket):
1) Export invoice_line_items for invoice_id X.
2) Run both summations: a) per-line rounding: SUM(ROUND(amount,2)), b) invoice rounding: ROUND(SUM(amount),2).
3) Compare VAT calculation: VAT_rate * subtotal_precise then round vs VAT_rate * subtotal_perline then round.
4) Regenerate invoice PDF template using chosen rounding method.

Maya Patel: quick patch suggestion from eng side to support both behaviors via config flag (billing.rounding_mode = "per_line" | "per_invoice"). Small diff in invoice generator.
Thomas Li: I can draft a PR and unit test showing stable behavior, plus migration script to re-emit PDFs for impacted invoices.
Raja Singh: thanks. tagging next steps in ticket: finance review, legal check on region requirements, customer approval for corrected invoice, eng PR + regen script, support to communicate.
Maya Patel: I'll message customer with interim note: "we are investigating, identified rounding behavior change on 2026-02-25, will follow up with corrected invoice if needed." :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Ticket INC-2026-1243 created and linked to customer ACMECorp; severity P2.
